text:
sara_pm: Quick sync — PRD (lite) for Docs-as-spec launch criteria and scope tradeoffs. Customer-driven ask: ACME wants Private deploy + SSO on day 1. We need a decision by EOD. Thoughts?

 tom_eng: We can do a minimal Private option but it'll add ~3 sprints (infra + KMS). Can we delay SSO to v1.1?

 jordan_lead: +1 to delaying SSO. Launch must not be blocked by enterprise auth. If ACME is gating, propose a limited pilot with NDA and manual onboarding.

 nina_docs: For docs-as-spec acceptance, I propose the quickstart includes:
```
- minimal example: repo -> config -> deploy (3 commands)
- examples: sample prompt set + expected outputs (edge cases listed)
- prod checklist: SLOs, rollback steps, monitoring hooks
```

 liam_devex: Also want explicit perf guardrails: token latency < 150ms p50 for hosted, and for Dedicated we publish throughput targets. If caching/batching required, call it out.

 sara_pm: Good. Drafting acceptance criteria now — will list must-haves vs nice-to-haves. Must-haves: basic private deploy (air-gapped optional), example app, PRD tests, docs-as-spec quickstart. Nice-to-have: SSO, console SSO integration, onboarding automation.

 tom_eng: Risk: private deploy + KV encryption increases complexity. We should scope the initial Private as 'network-isolated with customer-managed certs' and call out not-fully-airgapped.

 nina_docs: Edge cases to capture in PRD: long-context models (KV cache invalidation), model fallback behavior when capacity limited, examples showing degraded quality cases.

 jordan_lead: Suggest rollout plan in PRD: canary -> 10% pilot customers -> GA. Each step has acceptance tests and rollback playbook.

 sara_pm: Proposed launch criteria (draft):
- docs quickstart passes automated smoke (deploy example + run 5 prompts)
- example app reaches perf guardrails under staging load
- rollback documented and tested
- legal + sales OK for pilot customers

 liam_devex: I'll add a small test harness for the quickstart so docs can include `make smoke` that runs checks.

 nina_docs: I'll write the examples with explicit acceptance tests and attach to PRD as YAML snippets.

 sara_pm: Action items:
- tom: scope Private-lite and estimate (due EOD)
- jordan: write rollout + rollback plan (due tomorrow)
- liam: test harness stub (PR by tomorrow)
- nina: examples + acceptance YAML (PR by EOD tomorrow)

 jordan_lead: ack. I'll also add migration notes for customers moving from hosted -> private.

 deploy-bot: Deployed preview of PRD doc at https://redwood.internal/docs/prd-lite (preview)

 sara_pm: Thanks — will iterate. If ACME insists on SSO as must-have, we meet and reprioritize. :thumbsup:
